t: Iran, Tehran: The National Botanical Garden of Iran
s: An autumn morning in Iran's largest botanical garden, right by the Tehran–Karaj freeway: copper-coloured cypresses, yellow tunnels of ash trees, thorny trees by the lake, and everything you need to know before you go.

t: The Trip That Was Never Planned: From Bishkek to Issyk-Kul
s: A backpacker on his way home to Iran through Lebanon and Syria ended up in Kyrgyzstan instead: book-reading passengers, Bishkek's hospitality, nomad yurts, the red rocks of Jeti-Oguz and a lake that never freezes.
